transformer_manuals.title: Power Transformers: Dry-Type Operational Limits & Thermal Protection
transformer_manuals.section: Section 8.2: Winding Temperature Rise & Cooling Failure Diagnostics
transformer_manuals.content: Dry-type cast-resin transformers with Class F insulation have a maximum rated temperature limit of 155°C and an allowable temperature rise of 100K above ambient (40°C). Alarm threshold is set at 95°C and automatic emergency trip threshold is mandated at 110°C. Root causes: cooling blower loss, load unbalance (>10%), louver blockage.

transformer_manuals.title: Testing Procedures & Insulation Resistance Protocol
transformer_manuals.section: Section 14.3: Post-Fault Insulation Resistance (Megger) & Busbar Torque Specs
transformer_manuals.content: Insulation resistance test: 5kV Megger for HV windings (min 1000 Mega-ohms at 20°C). Polarization Index PI >= 2.0. Busbar torque: HV M12 = 85 Nm, LV M16 = 120 Nm.

mcc_manuals.title: Metal-Enclosed Switchgear & Busway Thermal Overload Standards
mcc_manuals.section: Section 6.4: Busbar Temperature Rise Criteria and Thermal Relay Tripping
mcc_manuals.content: In 415V 3200A MCCs, busbar joint temperatures must not exceed 75°C continuous (limit 90°C full load). Thermography delta-T > 15°C indicates loose fasteners or oxidation. Frequent thermal relay trips (>2/shift) indicate high enclosure ambient or overload.

mcc_manuals.title: Industrial Power Systems: Contactor Diagnostics & Voltage Sags
mcc_manuals.section: Section 9.5: Contactor Chatter Root Cause Analysis & Control Under-voltage
mcc_manuals.content: Contactor chatter causes micro-arcing and contact welding. Primary root cause: 110V AC control circuit voltage drops below 85% (<93.5V). Check control transformer secondary and shading ring cracks.

vfd_manuals.title: 315kW Heavy Industrial Variable Frequency Drive Troubleshooting
vfd_manuals.section: Section 5.1: DC-Link Overvoltage & Regenerative Braking Faults
vfd_manuals.content: Nominal DC-bus voltage: 560-585V DC. Warning at 720V DC, emergency trip at 740V DC. Causes: overhauling loads without DBR dynamic braking resistor or line surge.

vfd_manuals.title: Life-Critical Capacitive Energy Discharge & Harmonic Distortion Limits
vfd_manuals.section: Section 2.4: DC Bus Stored Energy Discharge Protocol
vfd_manuals.content: DANGER: DC capacitor bank stores > 800 Joules lethal energy. MANDATORY: Wait 10 minutes after AC breaker isolation for bleed resistors. Measure DC+ to DC- < 50V DC before touching.
